pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, sub-polygonal dark contiguous regions. Edges show smooth pixel gradients due to resolution. Patches on the upper neck are elongated while flank patches are more compact and rounded.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are prominent where three or more pathways meet. Pixel thickness of corridors is non-uniform, narrowing at points of closest patch proximity.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized area of intense dark pixel concentration and textural disruption on the mid-neck region, contrasting with standard patch pigmentation.
